name: Check Config Diff
description:
Reconfigure diagnostics: diffs the backed-up previous container .conf (from 103-host-backup-previous-container-conf.json) against the finalized new .conf and writes the differences to stderr, so they are captured in the diagnostic bundle and visible to the user.

Informational only — always reports PASS, never fails the deploy. Only runs when previous_vm_id is set (reconfigure/replace flows).
